name: SIRA Desktop Bridge
description: Exposes a session D-Bus interface (org.sira.DesktopBridge) that lets the local SIRA desktop-bridge daemon take screenshots and inject mouse/keyboard input on Wayland, via GNOME Shell's own privileged Shell.Screenshot and Clutter virtual-input-device APIs (the same mechanism GNOME's accessibility/remote-desktop features use internally). Enabling this extension IS the one-time consent step SIRA's owner already gave — there is no per-action dialog. Shows a permanent top-bar indicator whenever active. Targets GNOME Shell 45+ (the ESM extension format); GNOME 42-44 (Ubuntu 22.04's default Shell) needs a legacy-format port, not covered here.
